title: pm-dispatch round-report template should carry the UNRECOGNISED rows (governed surface, mandatory fable)
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` PM seat under ruling **Q2 → A** on **#9747 / PR #9875**. The dev correctly declined to make this edit: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` is a **governed surface**, off-limits to a dispatched dev. I said I would own it, and owning it means filing it here — the PM seat writes no code either.

## What shipped, and what it needs

PR #9875 gave two pilot gates a third exit state, printed on **every** run, green or red, at exit 0, unable to change an exit code:

```
UNRECOGNISED [engine-double-contract]: 23 construct(s) ... 117 further construct(s) are SCOPED OUT
UNRECOGNISED [durability-degradation-log-level]: 0 of 29 discovered seam(s)
UNRECOGNISED [durability-read-invention]: NOT APPLICABLE
```

The ruling on #9747 said these counts should be **visible in round reports**. They are greppable by a stable prefix, so no new context is needed — only a line in the round-report template telling the PM seat to grep `UNRECOGNISED` over the round's gate logs and carry the rows through.

## Why the `NOT APPLICABLE` row is the point

This is the part worth protecting, and it is why a template line beats leaving it to habit:

> **An absent row cannot be told apart from "nobody looked."**

A gate that declines to answer must say so *out loud*, and a round report that silently omits the row re-creates the exact defect #9747 exists to fix — one level up, in the reporting layer. A report with no `UNRECOGNISED` section reads as "nothing unrecognised", when it may mean "nobody grepped".

## Constraints on whoever takes this

- ⛔ **Governed surface.** The PR **will not be auto-merged** and **must not be flipped out of draft** by the agent — it waits for a human merge. That is not a failure mode, it is the rule (`docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`).
- ⛔ **Mandatory `claude-fable-5`** per the SKILL's own model-tiering rule: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` is tier-① mandatory-fable. The only downgrade exit is the 額度耗尽豁免 (maintainer, 2026-08-13: 「fable 如果用完了，可以用 opus」), applicable only when fable is measurably unavailable, never below opus, and the tier + reason must be recorded in the claim comment's `Container & model` line.
- **Keep it to one line plus, at most, one sentence of why.** The template is read every round by every seat; it earns its length. This is a reporting instruction, not a rationale essay — the rationale lives on #9747.

## Not in scope

Do **not** wire the `UNRECOGNISED` prefix into any gate or CI check. It is deliberately exit-0, visibility-only output; making it load-bearing would convert the #9747 pilot into the merge-blocking mechanism ruling 1 forbade.

Refs: #9747 (the ruling) · PR #9875 (what shipped and the exact prefixes) · #9866 (the open decision on generated artifacts under the same governed fence).
